name: Dennis Snellenberg
status: Desktop browser reviewed: home, footer and contact. Form not submitted.
look: Oversized sans-serif type, generous spacing, a dark closing section and a vivid blue circular action.
watch: Compare the homepage footer with the contact page. Follow the transition, inspect the question-led field rows, then return to the project list.
adapt: Use a confident closing headline, separate direct-email access and a spacious enquiry layout. Keep our existing labels and local email preparation.
avoid: Copying the portrait, signature circular button, loader or agency credentials. No new backend submission behavior.

name: Exo Ape
status: Desktop browser reviewed: hero and scrolled state. Contact structure checked from the live page.
look: Large white typography over full-bleed imagery, compact navigation and spacious editorial hierarchy.
watch: Scroll from the opening image toward featured work; compare scale and spacing. Open Contact and inspect the hierarchy around the email link.
adapt: Borrow breathing room, controlled type scale and the alternation of image-led and quieter sections.
avoid: Stock cinematic footage used as project evidence. Our work needs authentic screenshots before an image-led treatment.

name: Studio Freight
status: Desktop browser reviewed: opening image mosaic and a scrolled project composition.
look: A white canvas, serif typography and project imagery arranged around a central title.
watch: Scroll slowly through the opening mosaic and observe how the project composition changes around the headline.
adapt: Make the project images feel curated and give each project a distinct visual composition within a consistent frame.
avoid: Replicating the full mosaic or inventing project visuals. Four genuine project assets are more useful than many decorative tiles.

name: Studiogusto
status: Desktop browser reviewed: media-led opening and a scrolled state. Full project journeys not audited.
look: Dark media, a large lowercase wordmark and very restrained navigation.
watch: Watch the opening media, then scroll once. Study how the wordmark stays legible against changing imagery.
adapt: Treat large type as composition and use a single strong visual moment rather than repeating identical reveals.
avoid: Autoplay-heavy media throughout the portfolio or hiding service information behind a reel.

name: Hovercraft Studio
status: Desktop browser reviewed: work index. Motion details and mobile behavior need a follow-up audit.
look: Bold black typography on white, unusually proportioned project images and concise project metadata.
watch: Browse the work index and compare image widths, crops and labels. Use it chiefly to study composition.
adapt: Vary authentic screenshot crops and strengthen the separation of project title, role and delivery stage.
avoid: Assuming visual variety requires complex scroll effects; the strongest lesson here is layout.

name: Lusion
status: Desktop browser reviewed: opening 3D scene and navigation. Full interactive experience not audited.
look: Pale background, black-and-cobalt sculptural forms and compact rounded navigation controls.
watch: Inspect the opening scene and how the controls frame it, then explore a featured project on your own device.
adapt: Use one original abstract accent and a consistent motion language. A lightweight SVG could support our identity without a 3D runtime.
avoid: Adding WebGL, physics or a new animation framework just to imitate the reference.
fit: Motion ambition, not our base layout

name: Unseen Studio
status: Desktop entry screen reviewed. The world interaction was not entered; immersive behavior is described in the linked WordPress showcase.
look: A soft pink entry screen, playful eye motif and minimal entry controls.
watch: Compare the entry screen with the published showcase description. Review the world separately before choosing any specific motion from it.
adapt: A memorable signature motif can unify the site; our monogram can play that role.
avoid: An entry gate, audio dependency or drag-to-explore navigation for prospective clients.

name: Locomotive
status: Official page content retrieved. Browser inspection stopped at a security-verification screen; current motion is not verified.
look: The published page organizes featured work, agency information and extras. Visual and motion direction require manual review.
watch: Open the site in your own browser and inspect the opening typography and featured-work sequence before promoting this reference.
adapt: Potential reference for structuring a design-and-development identity. No specific effect is approved from this entry yet.
avoid: Treating legacy videos or the studio's scroll-library reputation as evidence of today's site behavior.
